summary: The Goshen Township Board of Trustees held their regular meeting covering a zoning map amendment for Goshen Storage expansion, employee benefits renewals for 2027, the comprehensive 2027 budget presentation, and several other administrative matters. The board approved rezoning property at 1642 State Route 28 from B-2 to PDB with 13 conditions for a self-storage expansion, adopted favorable health insurance renewals with a 0.6% medical increase and one-time $500 HSA contributions, and hired a new full-time police officer. The budget presentation highlighted the significant impact of the host community dispensary fund generating approximately $235,000 annually, representing a 20%+ increase in general fund revenue.

notes: The meeting date of October 27, 2026 is notably in the future, which is unusual. The applicant (Billy Kong/MNZ Oxford LLC) for the zoning case was not present at the hearing but the case proceeded and was approved. The board discussed the significant positive fiscal impact of approving a marijuana dispensary in the township, noting other communities that declined missed the opportunity. Property tax delinquencies were flagged as a concern across multiple funds. The zoning department has become self-sustaining after historically requiring general fund transfers. The board entered executive session for approximately one hour (7:44-8:53 PM) regarding employee compensation and union negotiations, after which they appointed a new police officer. The policy manual revision took approximately 10 months to complete.
